## Game Idea: Neon Grid Escape

A top‑down endless runner where the player controls a glowing orb navigating a procedurally generated neon grid. The orb automatically moves forward; the player taps or clicks to change direction (up/down/left/right) to dodge static and moving obstacles. The speed gradually increases.

**Lose condition:** Colliding with any obstacle or moving off the visible grid ends the game.

**Goal:** Survive as long as possible and achieve a high score based on distance traveled.

1: // Simple Neon Grid Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: // Audio setup
4: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
5: function playTone(freq, duration) {
6:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
7:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
8:   osc.type = 'sine';
9:   osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
10:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
11:   osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
12:   osc.start();
13:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
14: }
15: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
16: canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
17: canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
18: window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
19:   canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
20:   canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
21: });
22: let orb = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2, r: 10, vx: 0, vy: 2 };
23: let orbTrail = [];
24: let obstacles = [];
25: let speed = 2;
26: let score = 0;
27: let lastObstacle = 0;
28: function addObstacle() {
29:   const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
30:   const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
31:   let x, y, dx, dy;
32:   switch (side) {
33:     case 0: // left
34:       x = -size; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; dx = speed; dy = 0; break;
35:     case 1: // right
36:       x = canvas.width + size; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; dx = -speed; dy = 0; break;
37:     case 2: // top
38:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -size; dx = 0; dy = speed; break;
39:     case 3: // bottom
40:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + size; dx = 0; dy = -speed; break;
41:   }
42:   obstacles.push({ x, y, r: size / 2, dx, dy });
43: }
44: function update(dt) {
45:   // Update orb position
46:   orb.x += orb.vx * dt;
47:   orb.y += orb.vy * dt;
48: 
49:   // Add current position to trail
50:   orbTrail.push({ x: orb.x, y: orb.y, alpha: 1 });
51:   // Fade trail particles
52:   orbTrail = orbTrail.map(p => ({ ...p, alpha: p.alpha - 0.02 })).filter(p => p.alpha > 0.05);
53: 
54:   orb.x += orb.vx * dt;
55:   orb.y += orb.vy * dt;
56:   if (orb.x < 0 || orb.x > canvas.width || orb.y < 0 || orb.y > canvas.height) gameOver();
57:   obstacles.forEach(o => { o.x += o.dx * dt; o.y += o.dy * dt; });
58:   obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x > -50 && o.x < canvas.width + 50 && o.y > -50 && o.y < canvas.height + 50);
59:   for (let o of obstacles) {
60:     const dx = o.x - orb.x, dy = o.y - orb.y;
61:     if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < o.r + orb.r) gameOver();
62:   }
63:   if (performance.now() - lastObstacle > 1500) { addObstacle(); lastObstacle = performance.now(); }
64:   speed += 0.00001;
65:   orb.vx = 0; orb.vy = speed;
66:   score += dt * 0.01;
67: }
68: let last = performance.now();
69: let running = true;
70: function loop() {
71:   if (!running) return;
72:   const now = performance.now();
73:   const dt = (now - last) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps
74:   last = now;
75:   update(dt);
76:   draw();
77:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
78: }
79: function draw() {
80:   // Draw neon grid background
81:   const gridSize = 40;
82:   ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f0f0f';
83:   ctx.lineWidth = 1;
84:   for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += gridSize) {
85:     ctx.beginPath();
86:     ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
87:     ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
88:     ctx.stroke();
89:   }
90:   for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += gridSize) {
91:     ctx.beginPath();
92:     ctx.moveTo(0, y);
93:     ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
94:     ctx.stroke();
95:   }
96: 
97:   // Draw trailing particles
98:   if (orbTrail) {
99:     ctx.save();
100:     ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
101:     orbTrail.forEach(p => {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
104:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${p.alpha})`;
105:       ctx.fill();
106:     });
107:     ctx.restore();
108:   }
109:   ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
110:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
111: ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, orb.r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
113:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.9)';
114:     ctx.shadowColor = 'cyan';
115:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
116:     ctx.fill();
117:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
118:   ctx.fillStyle = 'magenta';
119:   for (let o of obstacles) {
120:     ctx.beginPath();
121:     ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
122:     ctx.fill();
123:   }
124:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
125:   ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
126:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 30);
127: }
128: function gameOver() {
129:   running = false;
130:   ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
131:   ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
132:   ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 100, canvas.height / 2);
133: }
134: canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
135:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
136:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
137:   // Play a tone when direction changes
138:   playTone(400, 0.1);
139:   const nx = orb.vy;
140:   const ny = -orb.vx;
141:   orb.vx = nx;
142:   orb.vy = ny;
143: });
144:   const nx = orb.vy;
145:   const ny = -orb.vx;
146:   orb.vx = nx;
147:   orb.vy = ny;
148: });
149: loop();
